serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I have a few mixed feelings about the recent blog post…
It’s a good thing that DAK was kicked out from the organization, but there was no information about what he did or what he was trying to do…
I guess I have bigger problems for now…
DAK is after me, he even wrote it in the comments…
What am I supposed to do? I can’t be hiding in my apartment forever! 
He could even kill me in here, like for example releasing poisoned gas through the gap below the doors…
I-I need to ask Little Richard for help!
He talked with the Admin, right? Weren’t they supposed to do something about it? Banning DAK on some stupid revolutionary blog doesn’t fix a single thing!
AbusedTenant: It’s me again, Richard. What are we going to do with DAK?
Little_Richard: He’s banned, right? 
AbusedTenant: He is, but how does that help me, exactly? 
AbusedTenant: Didn’t you see his comment on the blog? He’s totally going to kill me!
Little_Richard: He wrote something in the comments? Let me check.
…
Little_Richard: Fuck, I just read the comment
Little_Richard: Listen, I have no idea what to do. Wait a little longer, I will ask the Admin
AbusedTenant: What am I supposed to do in the meantime? I can’t stay here forever! 
…
AbusedTenant: Are you there?
